io.writer

Class AbstractWorkbook

  • java.lang.Object
    • io.writer.AbstractWorkbook
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    ExcelWritable, Writable, java.lang.AutoCloseable
    Direct Known Subclasses:
    WriteWorkbook, WriteWorkbookStreaming

    public abstract class AbstractWorkbook
extends java.lang.Object
implements ExcelWritable
    Provides a partial implementation of the ExcelWritable contract for creating and writing data to Excel workbooks using Apache POI.

    Subclasses are responsible for validating the workbook file extension and creating worksheets.

    Change log:

    • 2 November 2021 - Initial creation.
    • 7 October 2026 - Simplified internal state access by declaring fields protected and removing redundant accessors.
    Since:
    2 November 2021
    Version:
    0.7
    Author:
    Trevor Maggs

      • AbstractWorkbook

        public AbstractWorkbook(java.lang.String file)
        Creates an instance configured to produce a new Excel workbook using the specified output file and the default worksheet name.

        The file extension is converted to lower case before the workbook type is validated.

        Parameters:
        file - the relative or absolute path of the output file

        tabName - the name of the worksheet to be created

      • insertCell

        public <T extends java.lang.Number> void insertCell(T num)
        Inserts a numeric value into the next cell of the current row.

        The value is converted to a double before being written to the workbook. Consequently, numeric types requiring greater precision than double provides may lose precision.

        Specified by:
        insertCell in interface Writable
        Type Parameters:
        T - the type extending Number
        Parameters:
        num - the numeric value to insert, or null for a blank cell

                 throws TabularDataException
        Processes an array of headers and writes them onto the worksheet at the current row location. Default styling includes bold 12-point text, top vertical alignment, and text wrapping.

        Parameters:
